column1: # coverage.py --categories: the code the reconstruction does not cite, sorted
# by why.  Each line is `category<TAB>regex`; the regex is searched for in a
# function's mangled name and the first rule that matches wins, so the more
# particular rules come first.  What no rule takes is "other" - the work that
# is genuinely left (docs/next-steps.md, "What the uncited ROM is").
#   python tools/newton-rom/analysis/coverage.py build/MP2x00US \
#       --categories tools/newton-rom/analysis/uncited-categories.tsv [--show other]
# the ROM domain manager (page faulting packages and large objects in; the
# host keeps a mapped object whole) and execute-in-place packages, which only
# a package flagged 0x08000000 asks for; RelocateFramesInPage is the frames
# half of a store package's page relocated to where the domain maps it (the
# host maps a package unrelocated and resolves its import refs on import -
# RelocateImportRefs, Units.h), CheckObjectAlignment is XIPAddPackage's
declined: ROM domain manager, XIP
# AppleTalk and everything on it: LocalTalk, DDP, ATP, NBP, ZIP, RTMP, AEP,
# ADSP, PAP, the Chooser's zones and lookups, the AppleTalk printers
declined: AppleTalk
# the StyleWriter and LaserWriter LS drivers and the old print driver parts
# (EncodeLine is their raster compressor, called by nothing else)
declined: StyleWriter, LaserWriter LS
# --- the MessagePad's own hardware (the host has its own behind hal/) ------
hardware
# the memory system's machinery: the MMU's page tables, physical pages, the
# stack manager, the domains - the host's memory is its own
memory system: MMU, pages, stacks
# system patches (the host has none to install)
system patches
debugger, test harness, diagnostics
# --- communications the owner has not asked for ---------------------------
comms: eWorld, online services, P3, mux, keyboard, TV remote
# nothing in the U.S. ROM reaches these: the math views (no form makes one),
# the sixteen-bit dictionaries, the French/German accent checks, text at an
# angle and TextArrow, the package validation driver (never registered);
# LengthOfTraj and CurvFromSquare are the accent check's alone; the ink
# codec's default point sink and source, which DecoderOpen/EncoderOpen put
# in a context and their only callers (Decode, GenericCSCompress) replace
# before the run
dead in the U.S. ROM
# nothing in the ROM refers to these at all - no call, no branch, no
# address as data (callgraph.py --callers) - and they are not in the public
# jump table a package's native code calls through
unreferenced
# a protocol interface's methods are three-instruction stubs through the
# implementation's dispatch table, which the host's virtual call stands in
# for; most are cited at the interface's declaration, these are not
protocol glue
# --- the compiler's and the C library's runtime, and overloads -------------
# array new/delete helpers, pure-virtual stubs, the NSSend family's fixed-
# argument overloads (the host has one variadic form of each), RefStruct's
# constructors
runtime and overloads
# --- performance variants (the host's blitter and loops are its own) --------
performance variants
# --- public API the ROM itself does not call -------------------------------
# in the public jump table (0x01800000) for packages' native code, and
# nowhere called, branched to or pointed at by the ROM (callgraph.py
# --callers): a package's native code that calls one runs on armcpu, which
# answers it by name or runs the ROM's own copy (docs/armcpu/README.md) -
# the idle timer, the GC-safe lists and their collector procs, the
# unicode task table, RefToUniChar and the other out-of-line copies of
# inlines, TView's TCommand overloads, TEndpointEventHandler's services
public API the ROM does not call
# the text objects' TextWalker, which hands the layout and the drawing a
# style run's characters at a time through the options' scanner: the host
# takes them whole (qd/TextObject.h's TTextObjectChars, DEVIATION), asking
# the scanner to hold them (-2) and let them go (-1) as InitTextWalker and
# ReleaseTextWalker do
host stand-ins (DEVIATION)
